newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures close firmer, specs steady buyers.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures close firmer, specs steady buyers.

text.p: Frozen concentrated orange juice futures ended higher and towards the top of the recent trading range, buoyed by speculative buying, traders said.

Market sources expect the benchmark May contract to hold around 85.00 cents until April 4, when May options expire. They noted heavy open interest in May 85.00 calls of 1,850 lots, in May 90.00 calls of 2,621 lots, and in May 85.00 puts at 1,029 lots.
Players "might be trying to keep futures around the 85.00 cent level until options expiry," an analyst said.

The speculators were cited as early sellers and the trade as a light buyer. Around midday, the speculators reversed their position and touched off light stops around 84.50 cents in May, carrying the spot month to its high of 85.00 cents, the top of the trading range.
The contract closed at 84.70 cents, up 1.00, while the outer months settled 1.55 weaker to 0.55 firmer.
Volume was estimated at 3,000 lots compared with Friday's official 1,135 lots.
Support was seen at 80.00 cents and then 77.50 cents in May. Resistance was seen at 85.00 cents and then at 86.90 cents.
